title: Staff relays that release money are not in the audit log, and some do not record who did them
evidence: services/shield_link/router.py:265 api_record_milestone(ref, req) and :276 api_record_loading(deal_id, req) take no user; services/escrow_guard/router.py:218 open-window and :232 clear-dispute take no user; grep audit_log.record shows only pi.extended, escrow.release_relayed_by_staff, approvals, merge, screening, compliance.hold_cleared, kill_switch, prospect.dropped — QC result relay (shield_link/router.py:170), DELIVERED milestone (opens the acceptance window → auto-release of the final tranche), loading record (unlocks T2 + freight), dispute clearance, supplier order confirmation / PO ack by phone are not recorded
impact: One staff click (or a stolen session) can mark goods delivered, inspected or loaded, or lift a buyer dispute — each one moves escrow money — with no tamper-evident record of who and why
fix: Require the signed-in staff user on every relay route (milestone, loading, open-window, clear-dispute, QC status, supplier commitment confirm / next / po-ack, qc-readiness, party contact change) and write each to audit_log with the reason and evidence ref
why_money: a disputed release can be defended (or a wrong one traced) instead of written off

title: FX gain / loss reaches the journal but not the realised margin
evidence: shared/orchestration/fx_book.py posts fx_gain_loss in services/escrow_guard/journal.py; grep fx_book services/escrow_guard/service.py → nothing: realized_margin_usd, money_glance and profit/accuracy ignore it
impact: A 1-rupee move on a USD 40,000 payout is ~USD 470; the deal board and the radar's accuracy correction learn the wrong margin
fix: Add fx_gain_loss_usd to the ledger and subtract / add it in realized_margin_usd (and therefore money_glance and accuracy)
why_money: pricing learns from the margin actually banked
